# ANALYSIS: Stage-1 Backtest Viability Assessment

**Filed:** 2026-08-24

**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to assess whether the current engine (or a proposed change) meets the OP-16 thresholds: edge_capture ≥ 771 on J days, OOS Sharpe ≥ 0.70, and real-fills validation on top 3 J days within ±20% deviation.

## Mechanism

Run Stage-1 backtest using the existing codebase and parameters, compute edge_capture on the six J anchor days, compute OOS Sharpe over a held-out window, and compare BS-sim vs real OPRA fills on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04).
